title: Speed truth (early lane): shadow at foul, dots, arrows
instructions:
Validation-only truth for the EARLY-LANE (release/skid) speed — the headline number — with NO pin contact and NO lane geometry from the engine. For each clip, mark the frame the ball's SHADOW (its contact point on the lane) crosses each line: the foul line, the dot line, and the arrow line. True early speed = (your tape-measured distance between two lines) / (time between those frames).

BEFORE labeling, TAPE-MEASURE your home lane ONCE and enter the two distances below (they are lane constants, so the same numbers apply to every clip shot on that lane):
  - foul line -> the DOTS (the row of guide dots past the foul, ~7 ft): measure foul line to the CENTRE of the dots, in INCHES.
  - foul line -> the ARROWS (the second-arrow row, ~15 ft): measure foul line to the CENTRE of the arrows you are marking, in INCHES.
Measure along the boards (down-lane), from the foul line edge nearest you. If a line is not clearly visible in a clip, mark it 'Not visible' (n) and the pair is skipped. These distances are TRUTH ONLY and must NEVER be used as a runtime anchor.

Each moment opens at a rough estimate; step frame-by-frame with the arrows and press Enter on the exact frame. Click the frame to zoom.

fields.label: Tape: foul → dots (inches)
fields.help: Your measured distance from the foul line to the centre of the dot row, in inches (≈84 in if standard 7 ft). Lane constant — same for every clip on this lane.

fields.label: Tape: foul → arrows (inches)
fields.help: Your measured distance from the foul line to the centre of the arrow row you mark, in inches (≈180 in if standard 15 ft). Lane constant.

events.label: Shadow crosses the FOUL line
events.help: First frame the ball's shadow (contact point on the lane) is over the foul line (nearest you).

events.label: Shadow crosses the DOTS
events.help: First frame the ball's shadow is over the dot row (~7 ft). 'Not visible' if the dots aren't clear.

events.label: Shadow crosses the ARROWS
events.help: First frame the ball's shadow is over the arrow row (~15 ft, the row you tape-measured).
